About FunPlay Systems: Playground Equipment Makers Since 2002

Turn your playground dreams to reality

We Design Original Concepts

We have dedicated R&D Team to work upon innovative concepts. Most of our products are also protected by design registration.

We Craft Unique Play Experiences

All our products are crafted with play as the central character, emphasizing the importance of creating enjoyable experiences.

We Develop Inhouse

Inhouse Roto Molding Plant, Tested and Certified Raw Materials, Weather proof and Corrosion Resistant Materials, Customization Options Available

We provide After-Sales Service

Post that we have an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) that includes servicing of moving parts, inspection of wooden parts, and refinishing if required.

We provide Customizations

Our collaborative approach ensures each space is fun, safe, and reflects your vision. Whereas our tailored approach ensures that your play space is not only fun and safe but also distinctively yours.

Designer, Manufacturer & Supplier of Outdoor Play Equipment

Our Vision

To craft a joyful planet, by bringing power of play in people’s lives
We take care of our people, they take care of our customers
We are not done until our customer smiles
If its not safe, its not us
We Create, we Innovate and Deliver no matter what
Play shouldn’t cost the planet

Our Story

Turn your playground dreams to reality

 
 
 
 

Establishment of company “Funmold Engineering"

FunPlay Systems traces its roots back to 2002, when director Suraj Shetty, a gold medalist in engineering, envisioned starting a small business producing rotational moulded products. While working his day job, he began designing his own rotational moulding machine, a process that took a year of dedication. In 2003, Fun Mould Engineers was born. Mr. Shetty handled production using his passion for rotational moulding. The company started with just 5 moulds and 4 playground products. At the time, the playground industry in India was transitioning from metal to plastic parts. Mr. Shetty recognized plastic's potential to take over the industry. Leveraging his contacts, he provided spare parts to playground companies across India. As the sole manufacturer with an in-house rotational moulding machine, Fun Mould dominated the spare parts market. They started as just 3 people with 5 workers in a 3,000 sq. ft. facility.

 
 
 
 

Renamed to “Funplay Systems” and Started Playground Equipment

By 2005, he received his first order to fully manufacture a plastic playground slide. Without a sales team, he single-handedly managed every aspect. The years 2005 to 2010 marked Fun Mould's entry into playground systems, investing in new designs and products. After establishing itself in playground spare parts, Fun Mould Engineers set its sights on manufacturing full playground systems. They aggressively expanded their offerings from 2005 to 2010 with new slides, railings, canopies and more. As the company grew, so did the team. In 2005, with over 6 staff members and 50 workers, Fun Mould changed its name to Funplay Systems. By then, plastic had become dominant in the industry.

First Installed Multi-Play Product

 
 
 
 

Entirely converted to Roto Plastic Playground Equipment

Funplay transitioned from an engineering company into one that designs and innovates. They moved away from using fibre, focusing exclusively on LLDPE plastic playgrounds and their experience with engineering enabled them to become pioneers in the playground industry.

Team 2015-16

 
 
 
 

Shifted to 45000 sq. ft Factory Setup turned to ”Fun Play Systems Pvt. Ltd.”

By 2016, Funplay was a recognized leader in quality, design and innovation. They set up dedicated departments for HR, design and distribution in their 45,000 sq. ft. facility. With in-house manufacturing and imported machinery, Funplay could realise any design imaginings. Every year since 2016, Funplay has made it their mission to introduce breakthrough products and systems. Meticulous planning and research goes into brainstorming future innovations years in advance.

Awarded with “Entrepreneur Of The Year 2024” Title

 
 
 
 

Revolutionalizing playgrounds with our original and innovative design solutions

In 2022, Funplay pioneered engineered and natural wood playgrounds in India. Within 6 months, the market accepted these sustainable materials used in Europe. On April 9th, 2024, we unveiled a range of artistic designs that are truly one-of-a-kind that reflects childhood nostalgia, natural wonders and traditional game play.
